runs.notes: Cats famous on X, six angles: artists' comic cats (from @Nyazsche's memecoin comic), meme cats born on X, cat accounts, crypto-Twitter cats, celebrities' cats, viral 2024-2026. Each verified from its X post (api.fxtwitter.com) and a web source, then challenged by a second agent. Merged duplicates (Pépito, Sockington, Work Cat, Blue Cat). Not added: 26 rejected by the verifiers, 2 refuted by the challenger.
